scope: Independently submitted view DDL and valid UUID body/join controls; prior failed fixture attempts remain separate.

steps.label: graph-base
statements: CREATE TABLE GNodes (Id INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
CREATE TABLE GEdges (Src INT64 NOT NULL, Dst INT64 NOT NULL) PRIMARY KEY (Src,Dst)

steps.label: view-gstable
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GStable SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id FROM GNodes n

steps.label: view-gprojection
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GProjection SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id,GENERATE_UUID() AS V FROM GNodes n

steps.label: view-gbody
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GBody SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id FROM GNodes n WHERE RAND()<0.5

steps.label: view-gjoin
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GJoin SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT a.Id FROM GNodes a JOIN GNodes b ON a.Id=b.Id AND RAND()<0.5

steps.label: view-gkey
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GKey SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT GENERATE_UUID() AS Id FROM GNodes

steps.label: view-gbodyuuid
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GBodyUuid SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT n.Id FROM GNodes n WHERE LENGTH(GENERATE_UUID())>0

steps.label: view-gjoinuuid
steps.sql: CREATE VIEW GJoinUuid SQL SECURITY INVOKER AS SELECT a.Id FROM GNodes a JOIN GNodes b ON a.Id=b.Id AND LENGTH(GENERATE_UUID())>0

steps.label: finite-graph
steps.sql: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH FiniteGraph NODE TABLES(GNodes KEY(Id) LABEL Node PROPERTIES(Id)) EDGE TABLES(GEdges KEY(Src,Dst) SOURCE KEY(Src) REFERENCES GNodes(Id) DESTINATION KEY(Dst) REFERENCES GNodes(Id) LABEL Edge PROPERTIES(Src,Dst))

steps.label: path-trail-bounded
steps.sql: GRAPH FiniteGraph MATCH TRAIL (a)-[e]->{1,3}(b) RETURN DISTINCT a.Id AS src,b.Id AS dst ORDER BY src,dst

steps.label: path-trail-no-lower
steps.sql: GRAPH FiniteGraph MATCH TRAIL (a)-[e]->{,3}(b) RETURN DISTINCT a.Id AS src,b.Id AS dst ORDER BY src,dst

steps.label: path-trail-no-upper

steps.label: path-trail-star
steps.sql: GRAPH FiniteGraph MATCH TRAIL (a)-[e]->*(b) RETURN DISTINCT a.Id AS src,b.Id AS dst ORDER BY src,dst

steps.label: path-trail-plus
steps.sql: GRAPH FiniteGraph MATCH TRAIL (a)-[e]->+(b) RETURN DISTINCT a.Id AS src,b.Id AS dst ORDER BY src,dst
